exact_current_scan_law.consequence: A Builder.scan can invoke structural VZIP virtualization at most seven times. With eight or more deferred ZIP/WHL files the current product takes the container-pack path and never enters make_vzip_recipe for that cohort.

carrying_cost_bound.peak_transaction_metadata_scales_with: the largest single parsed archive's distinct staged content/Deflate hashes, not the sum across all deferred archives
carrying_cost_bound.note: This does not bound member count inside one nested archive; the 2,048/8,192-member stress courts remain relevant.

product_court_implication: Keep at least one 1-archive high-member supported case for success carrying cost.
Keep at least one <=7-archive mixed success/failure composition case for sequential journal composition.
Use >=8 deferred archives as an explicit negative control: both preimage and transactional postimage should take container-pack and be byte/tree identical because the transaction path is unreachable.
Do not extrapolate transaction overhead to large outer-archive cohorts where the product already selects container-pack.
claim_boundary: Structural source-derived execution bound. No product/release credit.
